lines.text: Paul asks the brothers not to be alarmed by any message claiming the Day of the Lord has already come.
The man of lawlessness will seat himself in the temple of Babylon, proclaiming himself to be God.
The restrainer will continue until he is taken out of the way, and then the Lord Jesus will slay the lawless one.
The lawless one will come with the working of Satan, and judgment will fall on those who delighted in wickedness.
God chose the Thessalonians from the day they were baptized, so Paul tells them to stand firm and cling to the traditions.
